caseName: United States Fidelity & Guaranty Co. v. Morrell
caseNameFull: United States Fidelity & Guaranty Company v. Mary L. Morrell
attorneys: Mr. E. B. Moulton, with whom Mr. George H. Huddy, Jr., and Mr. Frank F. Mason were on the brief, for plaintiffs in error. Mr. Henry C. Hart, with whom Mr. Theodore F. Green, Mr. Patrick P. Curran and Mr. Hoyt W. Clark were on the brief, for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction upon the authority of Farrell v. O’Brien, 199 U. S. 89, 100; Toop v. Ulysses Land Co., 237 U. S. 580, 583; Piedmont Power & Light Co. v. Graham, 253 U. S. 193, 195.
